name: diff_drive_car
description: Two-wheel differential-drive car controller. Composes two Motor instances for left/right wheels and adds high-level motion commands (forward, backward, spin, arc).

constructor_params.name: default_speed
constructor_params.description: Default speed 0.0-1.0 used by forward/backward/spin when not specified

properties.name: default_speed
properties.description: Default speed used by motion commands (clamped 0.0-1.0)

properties.name: left_motor
properties.description: Internal Motor instance for left wheel

properties.name: right_motor
properties.description: Internal Motor instance for right wheel

methods.name: spin_left
methods.description: Rotate left in place (left back, right forward). Aliases: turn_left, left

methods.name: spin_right
methods.description: Rotate right in place. Aliases: turn_right, right

methods.name: arc_turn
methods.description: Arc turn (one wheel faster than other). Alias: smooth_turn

example:
from machine import Pin
from diff_drive_car import DiffDriveCar
from time import sleep_ms

car = DiffDriveCar(Pin(14), Pin(15), Pin(16), Pin(17))
car.forward()
sleep_ms(2000)
car.spin_left()
sleep_ms(2000)
car.stop()
car.deinit()
esp32_notes: turn_ratio=0.5 means inner wheel at half speed. 0.0 = pivot one wheel, 1.0 = no turn (straight)
Multiple aliases (turn_left, left, smooth_left) for compatibility — all map to same method
If a wheel spins backward, set direction_left/right=-1 instead of swapping pins
hardware_notes: Requires two H-bridge channels (one per motor)
Use external battery — motor stall current can exceed USB 500mA limit
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard code requires manually composing two Motor instances. DiffDriveCar adds high-level motion primitives.
